source_note: 纯素读，仅读 text/ch10_ten.txt，未开 md。字符区间为该文件 0 基字符偏移 [start, end)。

events.did: 骑轻便摩托到护理院：休息室有马厩般的动物气味，约二十位（about twenty seniors）坐轮椅的老人像羊群一样围着一台电视；Yuko 认出一个特别小的背影喊了一声 Mom，母亲没有回头
events.quote_head: In the center of the room
events.quote_anchor: about twenty seniors in wheelchairs were gathered together like sheep

events.who: 母亲；护理院女工作人员
events.did: 母亲一见 Yuko 就问 Is my food ready yet?；工作人员微笑着称她 Ms. Setoguchi、告诉她刚吃过，母亲皱眉不信说自己还饿，工作人员便去拿点心
events.quote_anchor: “Ms. Setoguchi, you just ate,” the staff member replied with a smile

events.did: 母亲盯着 Yuko 在奢侈品店买的手套（自住进这家设施后很少与她对视），说 Mrs. Hashizume 偷了她的钱包、问 What should I do?，试图把轮椅从长椅旁推开；Yuko 按住轮椅安抚说银行里有钱，母亲提高嗓门问 Why would anyone steal?
events.quote_head: “You’ve got yourself some awfully nice gloves,”
events.quote_anchor: “Mrs. Hashizume stole my wallet,” she said. “What should I do?”

events.did: 母亲认出 Yuko 却以为她刚放学回家（瞳孔与眼白边界不清，盯着她确认是谁），问 Yuko 何时结婚、说 I really want grandchildren；Yuko 忍住不反驳，悄声向母亲借钱（Just a little bit），知道她银行里还有离婚和解金（divorce settlement）剩款
events.quote_anchor: “Mom, I need to borrow some money from you,” I whispered. “Just a little bit.”

events.did: 母亲陷入死寂后近乎耳语坦白 That flyer was a lie：指控父亲出轨的传单全是 Miyoko 编造的、她一直都知道（I always knew）；还说事情来得恰逢其时——她和父亲本来已无话可说（We didn’t have anything to talk about anymore）；Yuko 在母亲玻璃般的眼睛里仿佛看到了黑马
events.quote_head: My mother looked at me in surprise.
events.quote_anchor: I knew. The flyers accusing your father of cheating on me? Miyoko made all that up. I always knew.

events.did: 母亲道歉说 Yuko, I’m sorry I never told you，泪水从灰色的眼睛涌出、顺着眼角的皱纹滑落；坦白 Yuko 完全不再跟她说话、自己一直很孤独（I was so lonely）
events.quote_head: “Yuko, I’m sorry I never told you.”
events.quote_anchor: Yuko, I’m sorry I never told you.” Once she’d confessed her secret, tears overflowed from her gray eyes

events.did: 母亲说 All I want is for you to be properly happy；Yuko 不知 properly happy 何意，望向窗外太阳能板田野，觉得处处熟悉、仿佛直视着自己的未来
events.quote_head: “All I want is for you to be properly
events.quote_anchor: What did being “properly happy” mean? I didn’t know. I glanced outside at the field of solar panels.

events.did: Yuko 观察竞技场里的骑手：皮肤异常苍白、鼻梁高窄，看起来三十出头（in his early thirties），穿白色尼龙夹克，明显技艺高超；Mugikura 把他介绍给 Yuko——Atsushi Shintani，赛马骑师出身的障碍赛骑手（jockey turned show jumper），曾训练过参加过奥运会的马；Mugikura 决定让他在自己骑术俱乐部负责轻量运动与训练
events.quote_head: For a horseback rider, he had
events.quote_anchor: He was a jockey turned show jumper, and in the past had trained horses that had competed in the Olympics.

events.did: Shintani 问能否再多骑 Strada 一会儿，Yuko 点头后他喊 Ya! 让 Strada 跃入奔跑、冲向竞技场中央的障碍，在障碍前抬臀前倾；Strada 肌肉鼓起、精雕的腿收拢跃过栏架；Yuko 冻结的五感融化落泪，嫉妒 Shintani（Strada 正向他展示从未向自己展示的一面），嫉妒中又涌出神秘的渴望；Shintani 与 Strada 又完成 two, three more elegant jumps 后回到她身边
events.quote_head: “Yuko, would it be all right if I rode
events.quote_anchor: Strada’s muscles swelled, his chiseled legs folded, and he sailed over the hurdle.

events.did: Shintani 在夕阳下宣言 I’ll ride him；Mugikura 解释说他要与 Strada 参赛、帮它赢得比赛，Shintani 在 Strada 背上补说 He has what it takes；Yuko 心动：受挫的赛马 Strada 可能在障碍赛中重获聚光灯、他们可以一起重新开始生活（start our lives over again）；Mugikura 笑说 There’s only one answer
events.quote_head: “I’ll ride him.” He smiled, the sunset
events.quote_anchor: “I’ll ride him.” He smiled, the sunset at his back, his breath undisturbed by physical exertion.
